content.text: 用 aria2c 多连接下载 safetensors 文件。

input.command:
source /etc/network_turbo 2>/dev/null
MODEL_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/models/LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3___1-8B-Instruct"

# Create aria2 input file for the 4 safetensors shards
cat > /tmp/llama_aria2.txt << 'EOF'
https://modelscope.cn/models/LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct/resolve/master/model-00001-of-00004.safetensors
  out=model-00001-of-00004.safetensors
https://modelscope.cn/models/LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct/resolve/master/model-00002-of-00004.safetensors
  out=model-00002-of-00004.safetensors
https://modelscope.cn/models/LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct/resolve/master/model-00003-of-00004.safetensors
  out=model-00003-of-00004.safetensors
https://modelscope.cn/models/LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct/resolve/master/model-00004-of-00004.safetensors
  out=model-00004-of-00004.safetensors
EOF

nohup aria2c \
  --input-file=/tmp/llama_aria2.txt \
  --dir="$MODEL_DIR" \
  --split=16 \
  --max-connection-per-server=16 \
  --min-split-size=50M \
  --max-concurrent-downloads=2 \
  --continue=true \
  --file-allocation=none \
  --log=/tmp/llama_aria2.log \
  --log-level=notice \
  --console-log-level=notice \
  > /tmp/llama_aria2_out.log 2>&1 &
echo $!
